# Friend

> In-game friends and blocks, with invites and a client friend list.

- Package: `Friend` · Category: Social
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: [Cooldown](Cooldown.md), [Data](Data.md), [InviteQueue](InviteQueue.md), [Theme](Theme.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Friend")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Friend")` (shared/client keys)

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Friend.OnRequest` — `Signal<Player, number, string>`
  (toPlayer, fromUserId, fromName)
- `Friend.OnAccepted` — `Signal<Player, number>`
  (player, otherUserId) — fired for both sides on accept
- `Friend.OnRemoved` — `Signal<Player, number>`
  (player, otherUserId) — fired for both sides (the other side when in this server)
- `Friend.OnBlocked` — `Signal<Player, number>`
  (player, otherUserId)
